learning: PR #439 review feedback [@ajayky-os (core/src/main/java/com/google/cloud/gcs/analyticscore/core/GoogleCloudStorageInputStream.java:251): These readFully and readTail are used Iceberg's GCSFileIO when analytics-core is enabled, ensure it does not break any convention there.] -> Resolution: #4439593654: Verified against Apache Iceberg's `RangeReadable`, `SeekableInputStream`, `AnalyticsCoreUtil.GcsInputStreamWrapper`, and native `org.apache.iceberg.gcp.gcs.GCSInputStream` (the path used when analytics-core is disabled) — no conventions in `GCSFileIO` are broken:  1. **Stream position isolation**: Positional reads execute over a dedicated temporary channel in a `try-with-resources` block. The primary stream position `getPos()` and `channel.position()` are completely untouched, satisfying `RangeReadable` Javadoc ("position of the stream is not required to be updated based on the positional reads") and preserving our `read(ByteBuffer)` invariant (`checkState(channelPosition == position)`). 2. **Full-read looping (`readUpTo`)**: Loops partial channel reads until `length` bytes or EOF is reached, bringing `readFully` into strict parity with Iceberg's `IOUtil.readFully` and fixing a latent bug on `main` where a single partial channel read could throw a spurious `EOFException`. 3. **Empty object / EOF semantics**:    - `readFully`: Throws `EOFException("Reached the end of stream with ... bytes left to read")` on premature EOF or `position + length > size`, matching `IOUtil.readFully` and `GCSInputStream.readFully`. Throws `EOFException` for `position < 0` (Hadoop `PositionedReadable` convention) and returns immediately for `length == 0`.    - `readTail`: Returns `-1` on empty objects (`size == 0`, `length > 0`), which exactly preserves parity with native `GCSInputStream.readTail` (direct `readChannel.read(buffer)` -> `-1`) and matches our existing `readTail_emptyFile_returnsMinusOne` test. Returns `0` when `length == 0`. 4. **Bounds & error propagation**: Validates `(buffer, offset, length)` upfront (throwing `NullPointerException` / `IndexOutOfBoundsException` before any channel open, matching `Preconditions.checkPositionIndexes`), and preserves the `404 StorageException` cause on missing objects so `GCSExceptionUtil.throwNotFoundIfNotPresent` translates to Iceberg `NotFoundException`.

hypothesis: Evaluate and respond to review feedback on PR #469
learning: PR #469 review feedback [@gemini-code-assist[bot] (test-lib/src/test/java/com/google/cloud/gcs/analyticscore/client/TrackingReadStrategyTest.java:102): ![medium](https://www.gstatic.com/codereviewagent/medium-priority.svg)  In unit tests involving mock sources or simulated reads, it is a best practice to assert that the read operation was actually attempted and tracked (e.g., by verifying the read counter is incremented). This prevents false positives and ensures the correct code paths are executed.  ```suggestion   void getReadChannel_withEofAtCallConfigured_propagatesEofThresholdToWrappedChannel()       throws IOException {     ReadChannel mockChannel = mock(ReadChannel.class);     when(delegate.getReadChannel(0L, 10)).thenReturn(mockChannel);     trackingReadStrategy.setEofAtCall(1);      ReadChannel channel = trackingReadStrategy.getReadChannel(0L, 10);     ByteBuffer dst = ByteBuffer.allocate(10);     int bytesRead = channel.read(dst);      assertThat(bytesRead).isEqualTo(-1);     assertThat(trackingReadStrategy.getCurrentChannel().getReadCalls()).isEqualTo(1);   } ```  <details> <summary>References</summary>  1. In unit tests involving mock sources or speculative reads, assert that the read operation was actually attempted (e.g., by verifying a readAttempted flag or checking that a read counter is incremented). This prevents false positives from unstubbed methods returning default values and ensures the correct code paths are executed. </details>] -> Resolution: #4476456539: Declining: in this unit test, `channel.read(dst)` is invoked directly on the channel returned by `trackingReadStrategy.getReadChannel(...)`, and the underlying Mockito `mock(ReadChannel.class)` defaults to returning `0` (not `-1`). Thus `assertThat(bytesRead).isEqualTo(-1)` cannot pass via a false positive—it succeeds only if `eofAtCall` was propagated to the wrapped `TrackingReadChannel`. Furthermore, `TrackingReadChannel`'s `readCalls` increment on simulated EOF is already verified in `TrackingReadChannelTest.read_returnsEofWhenSimulated`, and `getCurrentChannel()` wiring is verified in `getReadChannel_withoutEofSimulation_wrapsChannelAndIncrementsCounters`, keeping this test focused on a single logical assertion per `GEMINI.md`.
